question: does one KL anchor to A0 measured on the un-tempered (T=1) logits stop the deployment-space drift that took the 20-dev first-death mean from 1636.8 to 889.35 frames at 50k?
declaration: R2 uses engine-truth reward and termination, so it is a training-time privileged diagnostic: it is NOT strict pixel self-improvement (R1) and no result here may be reported as R1.

revision.loss: loss += beta * mean_t KL(softmax(z_A0) || softmax(z)) on the RAW (untempered, T=1) logits
revision.per_rollout_statistic: max_t KL_T1(A0 || pi_t) over the rollout's own transitions, measured before AND after each update; the run's bound is the max of both

gate.note: fail-closed: the run is marked failed and exits non-zero when this is false; there is no tolerance band and no post-hoc relaxation

one_factor.note: the only added protocol factor is ppo.kl_anchor; the other added keys name where this arm writes (checkpoint tag, dev-eval dir/tag) so it cannot overwrite the audited R2 artefacts

kl_anchor.note: loss += beta * mean_t KL(softmax(z_A0) || softmax(z)), where z_A0 is a frozen, read-only second load of A0 (separate parameters, requires_grad False, never in the graph) and z is the policy's RAW logits — no temperature, because deployment is the argmax of the raw logits and the R2 collapse was measured there (3.276 nat at T=1 vs 0.281 nat at T=8). beta is frozen at 1.0 before the run and may only be raised; max_kl_nats is the pre-registered fail-closed bound max_t KL_T1(A0 || pi_t) <= 0.05 nat and may only be tightened.

death_penalty.counted: once per death, a first death does not end the episode

progress_total.unit: reward for traversing the whole first face by score
progress_total.counted: cumulative, hard-capped at progress_total per episode

progress_score_full.event: the score a real first-face clear reaches

survive_per_decision.unit: reward per decision at the two-frame beat
survive_per_decision.counted: 0.0: a bare survival constant is what §5 forbids, because at γ = 0.999833 (τ = 200 s) the discounted sum of a constant c is c/(1-γ) ≈ 6001·c and a long stall would out-earn a clear

progress_bound.meaning: a trajectory can never earn more than progress_total from progress, however long it stalls

floor.rule: the smallest τ in TAU_CANDIDATE_SECONDS whose γ^T at the measured clear length T = 6598 decisions reaches gamma_T_clear_min; ties broken towards the shorter effective horizon (the smaller τ)
floor.note: written before the revision ran and frozen after it; the thresholds are a visibility floor for a terminal event, not a tolerance that was moved to let a run through

discount.note: Δt = 2/60 s is the physical clock; τ = 200 s is the single diagnosed revision of the τ = 30 s initial configuration (at 30 s the terminal weight over the measured 6,598-decision clear was 6.55e-04, i.e. a clear bonus worth 1/382 of one death penalty). γ is always recomputed from Δt/τ and never read from the config

terminal.note: a terminal reward only reaches PPO on a terminated transition, so both counters have to be > 0 for a training run to be about the task objective at all

failure.reason: the KL anchor's pre-registered bound was exceeded
failure.consequence: the run is not a valid KL-anchored result; the checkpoint is kept for diagnosis only, and beta may only be raised

gate.note: fail-closed: the run is marked failed and exits non-zero when this is false; there is no tolerance band and no post-hoc relaxation

P1_mechanism.claim: max_t KL_T1(A0 || pi_t) <= 0.05 nat over 50,000 frames
P1_mechanism.pre_revision_value_where: forward_compare.json T=1 symmetric KL on the same 2x256 frozen slots

P2_function.claim: same 2x256 frozen slots: argmax flip rate <= 0.10 and max_a |mean_s dlogit(a)| <= 0.5

P3_behaviour.claim: 20 dev diag_first_death mean in 1473-1800 and s1n in 2710-3313

P4_discrimination.claim: if P1 and P2 hold but diag < 1473, the drift is exonerated and the next target is the reward/ruler misalignment
P4_discrimination.verdict: not triggered: the antecedent is not met, so the reward/ruler-misalignment conclusion is NOT licensed by this run

reproduction.note: both runs are the frozen evaluator on the same checkpoint sha (07fa0c69...) and the same 20 dev seeds, with different private engine data dirs; identical per-seed frames make the ruler's determinism a measurement rather than an assumption

coverage.diag: measured twice, independently (this run and r2_kl_p3.json)

cross_check_with_the_other_measurement.finding: the two independent 20-episode diag measurements agree to the frame on all 20 seeds; the s1n leg exists only in this run and is what decides P3's conjunction

headline.one_line: P1 fails (max_t KL_T1 0.8793 nat vs 0.05 nat); P2 fails (flip 0.01172, max|mean dlogit| 1.516); P3 fails (diag 1512.1 frames, s1n 2626.0); P4 not triggered

not_claimed: that this is R1 or a capability claim; R2 is a privileged diagnostic
that 50k frames can produce a clear; 0/20 is expected on both arms
that the anchor improves capability; at 50k it can only stop the drift
that a 1M-frame or 3-seed tier was run or is implied
that the reward/ruler misalignment was proven; P4 is only licensed when P1 and P2 hold and diag < 1473
blocking: the pre-registered bound is on max_t and it was exceeded (0.8793 nat vs 0.05 nat); the mean of those per-rollout maxima is 0.4017 nat, the mean_t KL of the final policy is 0.01676 nat, and the comparison-set KL on the same 2x256 frozen slots P2 uses is 0.005817 nat (max 0.08535); beta may only be raised, so closing P1's letter needs either a raised beta (a new pre-registration) or a bound restated on the comparison set
P3 is a conjunction over two rulers: ['diag_first_death'] holds and ['s1n'] does not (s1n 2626.0 vs [2710.0, 3313.0]), so P3 fails as pre-registered

P4 is not triggered: its antecedent needs P1 and P2 to hold AND the diag mean to fall below 1473, and the diag mean is 1512.1; the reward/ruler-misalignment pivot is therefore NOT licensed by this round, even though the reward's blindness is still measured and true

criterion_revision.what: P1's 0.05 nat bound is on max_t KL_T1 over a single trajectory's transitions (about 5x10^4 timesteps at T=1).  With A0's deployment row entropy at 0.24 nat, a handful of near-indifferent states set that maximum regardless of how well the policy is anchored: this run measured 0.8793 nat at max and 0.4017 nat on average per rollout, and 0.005817 nat (max 0.08535) on the same 2x256 comparison set the pre-registration's P2 uses.
criterion_revision.proposal: restate the bound on the comparison-set policy KL (mean and p99 on the 2x256 frozen slots) and keep max_t as a reported diagnostic; beta stays 1.0 because it may only be raised
criterion_revision.explicitly_not: this is NOT a relaxation of the code gate: rl.py still fails the run at max_t > 0.05 and this run is recorded as status=failed / exit 3.  The raw P1 and P2 numbers are in this file, unchanged, so a reader can judge the revision without trusting it
